journey.name: Review And Subscribe
journey.description:
Payer side of create-and-propose.xml. The proposed subscription arrives, surfaces under PROPOSALS, and opens the Review and Subscribe sheet where the payer swipes to accept. Accepting does not return to the list on its own: when the first period is due on acceptance the send flow starts and must be completed, otherwise the Subscribed confirmation opens directly. Both paths end on Close. Run this on the payer instance immediately after the creator sends the proposal.
iOS shows more on the review sheet than Android does: the provider card carries the counterparty's contact name and truncated pubky (id "SubscriptionCounterparty") under the cadence, and a line naming when the first billing period ends sits below the card. Neither appears on Android. The handoff's "Automatically pay this subscription" toggle is unbuilt on both platforms.
The swipe knob is brand orange, as the handoff draws it on all four subscription sheets. Android instead colours it by the balance the payment is expected to leave; iOS holds off on that until a designer confirms the intent.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled on the payer instance, with the creator saved as a linked contact and a spendable balance above 5,000 sats
Have the creator instance send the "Journey Sub" proposal as described in create-and-propose.xml
Open the drawer menu and tap Subscriptions
Verify a row for "Journey Sub" appears under the PROPOSALS section
Verify the Review and Subscribe sheet appears with 5,000 sats and the creator contact card
Verify the swipe control reads "Swipe To Subscribe & Pay" when the first period is due on acceptance, otherwise "Swipe To Subscribe"
Verify the swipe knob is brand orange, as on the cancel and delete sheets
Swipe the confirm control to the end
If the first period was due on acceptance: complete the send flow that opens, then verify the Subscribed confirmation appears
If no payment was due: verify the Subscribed confirmation appears directly, with no send flow
Tap Close on the Subscribed confirmation
Verify the sheet dismisses and "Journey Sub" moves from PROPOSALS into the ACTIVE section
Tap the "Journey Sub" row and verify the detail shows STATUS "Active" and a RENEWS date one month ahead, with no year
Only when a payment was made: verify the PAYMENTS section lists it titled "Journey Sub" with the payment date as its subtitle. With no payment yet, the section is absent.
